description: This file defines the CoreConfiguration class, which manages application properties in a Spring-based Java application. It provides methods to get and set configuration properties, with optional default values, and uses SLF4J for logging.

classes.name: CoreConfiguration
classes.description: A Spring-managed component providing property access and management, with logging capabilities.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns the Properties object containing configuration key-value pairs.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Sets the Properties object with new configuration key-value pairs.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with the specified property key.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with the specified property key, returning a default value if the key is not found.
